name: VUC Labs
summary:
**Welcome to the HF & VUC FYN Multiplayer VR Application**, an educational platform designed to transform how students collaborate, experiment, and learn. By combining virtual reality with modern pedagogy, this app opens the doors to a virtual campus where distance is no longer a barrier to teamwork.



Education is social. Students and educators can gather in the same virtual space as avatars, utilizing real-time voice communication to brainstorm, delegate roles, and solve school tasks together.
